name: Call Me by Fire
overview: Call Me by Fire is a music competition reality show by Mango TV, featuring male singers, dancers, actors, and producers. Through mutual challenge and collaboration, they define the spirit of "a burning life that always shines."

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Call Me by Fire is a music competition reality show by Mango TV, featuring male singers, dancers, actors, and producers. Through mutual challenge and collaboration, they define the spirit of "a burning life that always shines."

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Call Me by Fire S2 invites artists from various fields push creative limits through diverse music and performances. Honoring real-life heroes and stories, the show highlights perseverance, professionalism, and the evolving spirit of modern Chinese men.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Call Me by Fire S3, with the theme “Forging Ahead for China,”invites 32 male celebrities to showcase resilience and individuality through competition, forming the third generation performance family after multiple stages.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Call Me by Fire S4 is an all-male performance competition bringing together 34 entertainers for music battles and collaborative challenges, aiming to form the 4th generation "Hot-Blooded Family." This season expands to newer-generation artists, exploring diverse male charisma and honoring China's enterprising spirit.

Call Me By Fire 2025 is an all-male music competition show produced by MangoTV. 28 contestants form 7 teams to compete for the title of the ultimate group. The show blends generational music performances and cultural exchange, celebrating male resilience, cross-age collaboration, and boundless growth.

Call Me by Fire 2026 brings together 28 guests under the theme of “Ignite,” showcasing the spirit of breaking through limits in the new era. Through outdoor challenges and stage performances, the show follows their journey from “one person’s spark to a collective flame,” as they inspire themselves, light up each other, and grow together, delivering courage, positivity, and warmth to the world.
